# Software Bill of Materials

Human-readable rendering of [sbom.cdx.json](sbom.cdx.json) (CycloneDX 1.6, document version 2) for **dual-boot** — Dual-boot runbooks and scripts for adding Linux to machines shipping another OS

**27 components** (3 application, 2 firmware, 16 library, 6 operating-system). Generated by `test/sbom-md.py`; CI fails if this file is out of date with the CycloneDX source.
